processing.classification: amenity categories preserved; doctors/clinic → clinic; leisure park/garden → park; arts_centre → culture; tourism museum → museum.
processing.points: Original node coordinates, or a deterministic interior point from complete OSM polygon rings. Centroid accepted only inside the polygon, outside holes and inside bbox; fallback chooses an interior horizontal interval. Incomplete geometry is omitted and reported.
processing.bounds: Output Point coordinates must fall inside bbox. Crossing polygons receive an interior point inside bbox when possible.
processing.deduplication: Same normalized nonempty name + kind, node/area containment or at most 12 m; additionally a relation and its identically named tagged member way. Exact node position takes precedence; all original IDs and links are retained. Separate same-brand nodes and unnamed features are not merged.
processing.freshness: OSM snapshot only. Presence, names and categories reflect contributor tags; business operation and opening hours have not been checked.
